chinchin.tip: Bake or air-fry instead of deep-frying. Fibre-rich dough soaks up more oil.
chinchin.note: Low-moisture crunchy snack — easiest fibre win.

cookies.tip: Inulin can replace part of the sugar and add fibre. Dates also work as sweetener.

cakes.tip: Swap only 20–30% of flour at first. Add extra liquid — cakes turn dry and crumbly fast.

doughnuts.tip: Psyllium and citrus fibre form a gel that reduces oil uptake and keeps the inside soft. Offer a baked healthier line.

puff-puff.tip: These flours blend well into batter. Consider baked versions for the healthier line.

bread.tip: Soak bran/seeds 30–60 minutes. Use vital wheat gluten so bran does not collapse the loaf. Preferment or autolyse for texture.
bread.note: Agege bread is a perfect local base to reinvent — strongest health positioning.

meat-pie.tip: Fibre in crust and filling. Cold fat + rest keeps crust flaky. Legumes stretch meat cost and add protein.
